policy.overlap_policy: Allow duplicated target coverage only when one contributor relinquishes ownership; rank fewer unique structures and fewer relinquished atoms first.

result.interpretation: The 100-heavy-atom norvancomycin endpoint has been rejected and replaced by a complete geometric cover from materially smaller catalog structures. Literature comparison shows that this cover is not a known synthetic route: its flavonoid and glycoside matches are geometric coincidences rather than the protected amino-acid subunits used in vancomycin total synthesis.

literature_comparison.validated_step: N-demethylvancomycin plus SAM to vancomycin by MtfA/Vmt N-methylation
literature_comparison.published_total_synthesis: Vancomycin aglycon assembled from seven amino-acid subunits followed by two-step enzymatic glycosylation
literature_comparison.verdict: Geometric coverage demonstration only; reject as a retrosynthetic route.
